description:
Scene tools for the Draftless AI creative studio. Requires sign-in to run. Actions:
- list_scene_projects: List the caller's 3D scene projects (newest first) with revision and preview.
- get_scene_project: Read one scene project: revision, scene sequence (pass both back as guards), the typed scene document and 1 h signed GLB and preview URLs.
- create_scene_project: Create an empty 3D scene project.
- execute_scene_query: Inspect a 3D scene and render preview images; the scene itself is not changed.
- execute_scene_edit: Commit one coherent edit to a 3D scene from a prompt (typed scene operations) or explicit ops.
- execute_scene_tool: Run one deterministic scene tool: import (10 cr), rig (16), animate (12) or render (6 + 4/s, doubled at 1080p, up to 20 s).
- get_scene_operation: Poll a scene operation: status, logs tail, signed artifacts and revisionAfter.
- upload_scene_asset: Mint a one-shot signed upload URL for a .glb, .gltf, .fbx, .obj asset (up to 64 MB).
- add_generated_mesh: Copy a finished generate_3d mesh (a completed three_d job) into the scene asset folder, server-side, and return the assetPath for execute_sc
- list_scene_assets: List the caller's importable meshes: uploads already in the scene asset folder and finished generate_3d jobs.
- get_scene_export: Sign a download for the scene: glb, blend or mp4 (1 h link), optionally at a past revision.
- generate_scene_angles: Camera angles of a scene as photoreal stills: 1-6 orbit renders on the worker, then a Seedream 5 Pro edit of each at 1k, 1.5k, 2k in one of 
- generate_scene_angle_retry: Re-run ONE angle of a generate_scene_angles job whose image edit failed and was refunded (get_scene_operation lists it with retryable:true).
- create_scene_shot: Turn the scene into a video shot.
- get_scene_view: Render-ready view of a scene for a widget or a quick look: project, optional operation, artifacts and a web link to the Scene Builder.
- list_scene_catalog: Search the curated CC0 model catalog (Poly Haven: furniture, props, plants, containers, lighting, themed kits like the_shed or hidden_alley)
- add_scene_catalog_asset: Bring one catalog model (from list_scene_catalog) into a scene as a named, stageable object.

input.description: Arguments for the action (see discover.describe_action once signed in).

name: scene
title: Scene
